title: TEST: JSON vector files are non-empty but never parsed — tests use hardcoded hex
description: piv_apdu.json and openpgp_apdu.json exist and the test suite verifies they are non-empty. But no test reads the vectors from the files; all expected-APDU hex strings are hardcoded in the test C source. The files serve as documentation. Either: (1) add a parser and drive tests from the JSON (strong: catches drift between JSON and code), or (2) explicitly document that the files are human-readable spec references, not machine-driven fixtures, and the C code IS the test oracle. Pick one and commit to it.
